boundaries.config_identity: Python retains the dynamic config object identity; native copies one typed fixed-field snapshot before solve loops.
boundaries.dynamic_kwargs: Python ignores every constructor kwarg except verbose. Native accepts only the typed SolverConfigInput boundary.
boundaries.environment_class: Python registry env_cls is dead input. Native reserves no environment dependency in the base registry.
boundaries.learning: Learning categories are enum seams only; no RL/Torch/CUDA factory or import is linked.
boundaries.registry_freeze: Native explicitly freezes registration, then reads compact SolverId slots concurrently without name lookup.
